firstPlayerRule: Whoever was most recently in Vienna takes the city crest and is first player; the rulebook also allows whoever was closest to Vienna.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Everyone assigns cards simultaneously before the city-crest holder takes the first action turn.
